name: Vegas Poker
author: Addicting Games
description: Vegas Poker is an online card game where you can play against other opponents. Enter into this digital casino where you can play poker without ever losing real money. There are 5 levels for you to play and you want to win them all! Play against the 5 best AI players in town. They are experts in poker and will not go easy on you. That is okay with you because you are here to win everything! If you have a great poker face, you can bluff your way to the winning pot! However, it best to know the game for higher chances of winning. At the end of each session, submit your score to see if you land on the high scores list.
